args.title: Triage issue 4405
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In src/components/ExportButton.tsx, the export format is managed locally in state via useState<ExportFormat>(defaultFormat) with defaultFormat defaulting to "csv", and is not persisted in localStorage or sessionStorage. When the component unmounts and remounts (or the report page is reopened), the format resets to "csv". The issue requests remembering the export format last used in the browser.
